records.title: Name Format
records.html:
It is very important to record name information accurately, due to increasing Governmental requirements concerning Passenger Data. Ideally, the recorded name should match that in an official travel document, e.g. a passport. As this may not always be possible, please follow these guidelines:

 

SCENARIOS

EXPLANATION & FORMAT

General

Enter the surname in the last name field and the given names (first and middle*) in the first name field followed by the title.

 

*Middle name is not mandatory even when travelling to/from US and Canada, but all names should be updated in SSR DOCS (passport data).

Compound Names

When you have a hyphenated surname, an apostrophe in the surname or a double surname, delete the hyphen and apostrophe and replace with a space while entering the surname name in the last name field.


E.g. JAMES ROBERT BRYCE-BUCHANAN as BRYCE BUCHANAN/JAMES ROBERT MR

Single Letter Family Name

When a guest has a single letter as the family name, double the single letter and update in the last name field followed by the given names and title.

E.g. MISS MOAN Y as YY/MOAN MISS

 

We may also accept guests whose PNRs are created on other GDS where the single letter family name is combined with the given names of that guest and entered as the family name followed by the title.
E.g. MISS MOAN Y as MOAN Y/MISS

Duplicate

When creating a booking and names are an exact match, add middle names and/or different titles (if applicable) to make them unique. Otherwise you should create a separate booking. 
E.g. SINGH/JITENDER MR and SINGH/JITENDER PAL

No Family Name

When the surname is not available, update the name using one of the following formats:

·         Enter the given name in the last name field and enter the given name as FNU (First Name Unknown) followed by the title. LNU must not be used in the name field. Update the name on the booking as HABEEB MOHAMMAD/FNU MR

·         Enter the given name(s) in the last name field and add a title in the first name field is accepted by Etihad Airways. E.g. HABEEB MOHAMMED/MR

No Given/First Name

When the given names (first and middle) are not available:

(i) Enter the family name in the Last name field and update given name as FNU followed by the title of the guest.
E.g. JACK FRANCIS/FNU MR


(ii) Names without first name, but just the title in the given name field are accepted by Etihad Airways.
E.g. JANE AUSTIN/MRS

Name Suffix

To accommodate name suffixes (such as Junior, Senior or III) add the suffix to the surname in the last name field followed by the given name and title in the first name field.
E.g. MR.JOHN OLSEN JR. as OLSEN JR/JOHN MR

Long Names

Etihad reservation system accepts only up to 59 characters (including space, title, infant name along with pax type and date of birth) in entire name field. Last name must contain at least 2 alpha characters. . When the name is longer or when there is insufficient space on the ticket, add as many names as possible from the first name and last name on the passport and omit the rest. However, travel docs (SSR DOCS) must be updated with full names.

Example:

Adult name: LAKSHMIPATHY SAMIE KIRUTHIKAMAHESWARI

Update adult name as LAKSHMIPATHY KIRUTHIKAMAHESWARI

Infant name: JAYDEN KING CARTER VISHAKAN

Update the Infant name as JAYDEN VISHAKAN

Full Name on one line

If the full name is in one line on the passport, check the name on MRZ. MRZ refers to Machine Readable Zone, at the bottom of the identity page at the beginning of a passport.

Example 1:

If the full name on the passport is AHMED MAGED MAHMOUD ELSAYED SHAHIN and the MRZ is P<EGYSHAHIN<<AHMED<MAGED<MAHMOUD<ELSAYED<<<<

where, P  indicates the type of document  (Passport)

EGY indicates the country code

SHAHIN is the surname (surname always follows the country code without any space or separators)

AHMED<MAGED<MAHMOUD<ELSAYED is the first name and subsequent names

Update the name on the booking as SHAHIN/AHMED MAGED MAHMOUD ELSAYED MR

 

Example 2:

If the full name on the passport is RUKMINI BINTE HALIM and the MRZ PASGPRUKMINI<BINTE<HALIM<<<<<

One < means space and < < comes after surname. In this case, the guest does not have a surname, so the name must be updated as Rukmini Binte Halim/FNU

 

Name with special characters

While entering names with special characters e.g. umlauts, agents need to check the MRZ on the guest passport and enter the name accordingly.

If the surname is LÅÅS and the given names are GöRAN TONY BERTIL, and the MRZ is P<SWELAAAAS<<GOERAN<TONY<BERTIL

where, P indicates the type of document (Passport)

SWE indicates the country code

LAAAAS is the surname, Å is entered as AA

GOERAN<TONY<BERTIL are the given names where ö is entered as OE

Update the name on the booking as LAAAAS/GOERAN TONY BERTIL MR

Multiple Names

Some passports are issued with multiple names. For such scenarios, update one of the surnames /first name.

 

Example:

Name on Passport- Surname ZIOU OR ZIU and Name FLORINTA OR FLORIDA and the MRZ P<GRCZIOU<OR<ZIU<<FLORINTA<OR<FLORIDA<

Update the name on the booking as one of the following:

ZIOU/FLORINTA MS or ZIU/FLORIDA MS

 

Notes:

  • When making a reservation for an unaccompanied minor, use the SSR UMNR which includes the child's age, contact and other details. 
  • Group name is a unique name assigned by the booking office for the purpose of establishing the identity of passengers travelling together on one or more segments. 
  • SSR DOCS must be updated with complete first, middle and last names available on the passport 
  • While updating SSR DOCS, if there is no last name/first name in the passport, record the available name in the Last Name box and update FNU in the First Name box. 
  • Special passport requirements for entry into the UAE: 
    • If the passport has two fields, one for ‘first name’ and one for ‘surname’, and one of them is blank/FNU/LNU, the other field must contain at least two words (names). 
    • If a travel document contains ‘XXX’ in one of the fields, it will not be accepted. 
    • Travel documents with two names added as observations/annotations or with a second name added on any page are accepted if the names belong to the guest or to the guest’s father 
    • This requirement does not apply to guests with valid UAE Emirates ID.

Name on Passport- Surname ZIOU OR ZIU and Name FLORINTA OR FLORIDA and the MRZ P<GRCZIOU<OR<ZIU<<FLORINTA<OR<FLORIDA<

Update the name on the booking as one of the following:

ZIOU/FLORINTA MS or ZIU/FLORIDA MS

 

Notes:

- When making a reservation for an unaccompanied minor, use the SSR UMNR which includes the child's age, contact and other details. 

- Group name is a unique name assigned by the booking office for the purpose of establishing the identity of passengers travelling together on one or more segments. 

- SSR DOCS must be updated with complete first, middle and last names available on the passport 

- While updating SSR DOCS, if there is no last name/first name in the passport, record the available name in the Last Name box and update FNU in the First Name box. 

- Special passport requirements for entry into the UAE: 

- If the passport has two fields, one for ‘first name’ and one for ‘surname’, and one of them is blank/FNU/LNU, the other field must contain at least two words (names). 

- If a travel document contains ‘XXX’ in one of the fields, it will not be accepted. 

- Travel documents with two names added as observations/annotations or with a second name added on any page are accepted if the names belong to the guest or to the guest’s father 

- This requirement does not apply to guests with valid UAE Emirates ID.

records.title: Blind guests
records.html:
Blind and temporarily blind guests

 

Guests who are permanently blind are permitted to travel without obtaining medical clearance. Please let us know if your guest requires any specific assistance at the time of booking.

 

Guests who are temporarily blind are required to obtain medical clearance through MEDIF.

 

Please notify us of blind groups at least 48 hours in advance.

 

All reservations must be made through an Etihad Sales Office to create a PNR. Please make sure to add an SSR to the booking, select ‘BLND’ from the drop-down box and enter text as necessary, for instance, ‘UNACCOMPANIED’. Name and segment must be selected when you add the SSR.

 

Travelling with a guide dog
 

Guide dogs are permitted in the cargo hold for free as part of the checked baggage allowance. Always ensure that your guest has the correct permits and documentation for their pet to travel. Regulations may vary depending on the destination or country of departure, so it is always better to check well in advance.

 

Special assistance requests can be made through an SSR.

records.title: Etihad Priority Access
records.html:
Priority Access gives Economy guests the option to fast-track their airport experience with priority check-in and speeding boarding, as well as priority baggage when they land. Priority Access is available to purchase through our Global Contact Centres and travel agencies, or at the airport up to 90 minutes before their scheduled flight time. The ancillary will be available to purchase online in the future. Priority Access costs US $50 per person, no matter where passengers are flying to or from. 

 

What is Priority Access? 

 

Policy

  • An Electronic Miscellaneous Document (EMD) will be issued.
  • Fixed price of US $50 applies – this is non-refundable.
  • Applied on an origin/destination basis, for instance, a guest traveling from LHR to SYD will pay US $50 and get priority check-in and boarding in London, then priority boarding in Abu Dhabi.
  • For stopovers, bookings require two EMDs, for instance, a guest travelling from BKK to MUC with a stopover in AUH will have to buy an EMD for BKK-AUH and another one for AUH-MUC – this will cost US $100.

 

Procedure

Priority Access is available to purchase through our Global Contact Centres and travel agencies, or at the airport. An Electronic Miscellaneous Document (EMD) will be issued to fulfil the payment and the booking will be automatically updated.

records.title: Hajj
records.html:
If your customers are travelling for Hajj:

 

- They must have a machine-readable passport.     

- They must fly in and out of Jeddah Airport. 

- If your customer is travelling for Hajj and their visa also includes the name of another person, they must travel on the same flight as the person listed.

- Five litres of Zamzam water can be carried for free as checked baggage.

- If your customer holds a Business visit visa, they cannot enter Jeddah during the Hajj season.

- Guests must check the validity of their visa before they travel at visa.mofa.gov.sa.

- If they are UAE nationals or residents planning to travel from Abu Dhabi to Jeddah, they need a certificate showing they've had a seasonal flu vaccine.

- If guests are transiting through Abu Dhabi and their journey didn't start in the UAE, or if they have a medical condition that prevents them from getting the flu vaccine and have supporting documents, they don't need to get vaccinated.

- If they have been vaccinated in the past year, they are not required to have a new vaccination certificate.

- Before travelling for Hajj or Umrah, guests must check the health and vaccination requirements on the Hajj and Umrah Health Requirements website.

records.title: Groups
records.html:
A group is defined as a party of 10 or more guests in Economy, six or more in Business and four or more in First. Infants are not included in the group size. 

Group bookings must be created at an Etihad Sales office or via a dedicated group system, access to which has been provided by Etihad Airways. Travel agencies are not permitted to request groups in the GDS. 

All guests should be booked together on the same flight(s)/ departure dates at the time of booking. 

 

There are two major group types:

 

Adhoc Groups: 

A party of 10 or more guests (excluding infants) traveling together on the same outbound and inbound flights and dates. This is a one-off movement for specific dates.

 

Series Groups: 

Minimum of 6 consecutive movements of a similar group size (minimum of 10 guests)

from the same agent, or, 200 guests from the same travel agent in a travel pattern, for instance, 10 guests every Tuesday over the travel period 1 March to 31 October. 

Read more about group bookings

 

Note:

To know the instructions on how to do seating with Groups please view GDS entry to book Ancilliary Services and FOC seating Amadeus.

 

Etihad Groups email contact

records.title: Travelling with Infants
records.html:
- An infant is a child aged 7 days to 23 months as of the date of commencement of travel.

- Each infant must be accompanied by one adult. Each adult is only allowed to accompany one infant.  This is a GCAA safety requirement.

- It is possible for one guest to book tickets for more than one infant, however they must arrange for one adult per infant.

- The adult accompanying the infant must be capable of providing adequate care and assistance

- Entries for bookings with Infants:

 

Amadeus

NM1LEAVY/PATRIC(INF/MICHAEL/01AUG18)

Sabre

-I/JACK/LIVE*INF*05APR23
oder
I/JACK/LIVE*INF
3INFT/JACK/LIVE/05APR23-1

 

-  If the infant's name is long and does not appear on the face of the booking.  Update the infant's full name and date of birth in the SSR INFT field (e.g. SSR INFT EY HK1 HARRY/TOM MSTR 15FEB24).

 

Bassinets

Bassinets are carried in limited quantities on Etihad aircraft and can accommodate infants up to a maximum weight of 11kgs (24lbs) and no more than 75cm on the day of travel. The infant must not exceed 11kg and must fit comfortably in the baby bassinet.

At the time of check-in, if the infant is found to be over 11kgs (24lbs), the BSCT request will be removed and the guest will be advised. All guests with BSCT requests will be advised that cabin crew will check onboard to confirm the bassinet can be used safely.

Dimensions of a baby bassinet:

  • Length – 29 inches (75cm)
  • Width   – 13 inches (33cm)
  • Height – 8.5 inches (21cm)

records.title: Minimum Advertised Price (MAP) Policy
records.html:
Etihad Airways, the National Airline of the United Arab Emirates, invests substantial amounts of money to develop and bring to market innovative aviation products and services, including our award-winning airport lounges, cabin interiors, and inflight offerings.   We recognize that our authorized travel agents and other travel partners (collectively “Trade Partners”) also contribute to Etihad Airways’ success by investing significant time, and effort in helping promote Etihad Airways to the traveling public and educate them about our airline.   To facilitate this goal, Etihad Airways has established the Etihad Airways Territorial Minimum Advertised Price Policy (“MAP Policy”).  The MAP Policy is a unilateral policy of Etihad Airways and does not constitute any express or implied agreement between Etihad Airways and any other party or entity.  The MAP Policy applies to Trade Partners in the Territory, which is defined below.[1]

 

Under the MAP Policy, Trade Partners and other promoters and distributors of Etihad Airways products and services in the Territory may not advertise, promote, or publish to the general public any passenger fare or ticket distributed by Etihad Airways within the Territory for a price that is less than that of the Etihad Airways Current Published Fare.  The Etihad Airways Current Published Fare is the fare distributed by Etihad Airways and displayed in the applicable global distribution system(s) (“GDS”), including all applicable taxes, charges, surcharges, and/or other fees displayed in the applicable GDS(s). 

 

The MAP Policy applies to all advertisements by Trade Partners that include any Etihad Airways passenger fares in any media, including but not limited to flyers, posters, Internet sites, metasearch sites or other electronic formats, social media sites, newspapers, magazines, catalogues, television, radio, and public signage.  

 

Etihad Airways, at its sole discretion, reserves the right to discontinue doing business with and/or terminating inventory access to any Travel Partner or other party that violates Etihad’s MAP Policy.  Etihad Airways will enforce MAP Policy at its sole discretion and without notice.  Trade Partners have no right to enforce the MAP Policy – it is a unilateral policy of Etihad Airways.

 

[1]              As of this update, the Territory consists of the United States, Canada, Republic of South Africa, United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Kuwait, Bahrain, India, Philippines, Thailand, Egypt, Singapore, Pakistan, Malaysia, and Hong Kong SAR (China).

records.title: Pets in Cabin (PETC)
records.html:
Pets in the cabin (PETC) will not be permitted in First and The Residence on EY flights.  This does not affect trained service animals (SVAN) in First and The Residence, which will continue to be accepted as per our existing SVAN policy. 

 

Pet dogs or cats in cabin

  • Cats and Dogs are the only pets permitted to be carried on Etihad Airways flights.
  • Pets are permitted to be carried in Economy and Business cabins only. Pets cannot be carried in the First cabin and The Residence.
  • Pets are permitted on direct EY routes to, from or via Abu Dhabi on EY marketed (607 stock) and operated flights
  • These are only bookable through Etihad Contact Centres
  • Guests must be at least 18 years of age to be eligible to transport a pet.
  • It is permitted for a guest to bring one (1) cat or one (1) dog as a pet in the cabin
  • The maximum number of pets in the cabin per flight is as per the table below:

* May be increased to a total of two (2) where two (2) passengers are travelling together and wish to bring one (1) pet each from the same household/family.

** May be increased to a total of three (3) where two (2) passengers are travelling together and wish to bring one (1) pet each from the same household/family.

 

Note: Each pet must be in a separate travel kennel crate.

 

  • On a flight with falcons(s) travelling in the cabin, a pet (dog or cat) cannot travel in the same travel cabin as the falcon(s). If a guest is travelling with a pet dog or cat in the cabin and another guest is travelling with a falcon in the same class on the same flight, the request of the guest who made the first reservation shall be confirmed.
  • Where a guest with an allergy statement and a guest with a pet request are travelling on the same flight, the request of the guest who made the first reservation will be confirmed.
  • If a guest travelling with a pet dog or cat in the cabin and a guest travelling with a trained service animal is on the same flight, the request of the guest wishing to travel with a trained service animal will always take priority regardless of time of reservation.
  • The container (pet travel bag or kennel) must be within the maximum weight and dimension requirements for the applicable travel class (refer to sections 3.1 and 3.2) and must meet the following requirements:

o   The pet should be able to sit and stand in a natural position with its head fully erect (without touching the roof), turn around and lie down

o   The carrier must be ventilated on at least three (3) surfaces

o   The carrier must be escape-proof (rigid door for kennels / secure entrance for pet travel bag) and leak proof

o   The container floor must contain absorbent material

  • The guest will provide:

o   Absorbent material for inside the container, including sufficient spares and disposal bags

o   Dry food in a sealed container for the animal, sufficient for the duration of the journey.

  • The pet must not be allowed outside the pet travel bag or kennel whilst on board the aircraft.
  • The pet must be of a minimum of 16 weeks old.
  • In Economy Cabin,

o   For under-seat carriage, the pet must be able to fit in a pet travel bag or kennel with maximum dimensions of 40 x 40 x 22 cm (L x W x H) to fit safely under the seat.

o   For carriage on an adjacent purchased seat, the pet must be able to fit in a pet travel bag or kennel with maximum dimensions of 50 x 43 x 50 cm (L x W x H).

o   The pet travel bag or kennel shall be secured to the seat with extension seat belts.

o   The gross weight (pet and travel bag/kennel combined) should be no more than 8 kg.

  • In Business Cabin,

o   It is not possible to stow pets under seats.

o   An extra seat must be purchased adjacent to the accompanying guest and the pet shall be in a pet travel bag or kennel with maximum dimensions of 50 x 43 x 50 cm (L x W x H).

o   Contact Centre agent must ensure that there are adjacent seats available on the aircraft and block them before accepting the carriage of pet request. If there are no adjacent seats, an alternate flight must be offered.

o   The gross weight (pet and travel bag/kennel combined) must not be more than 8 kg.

o   Where two (2) passengers travelling together wish to bring one (1) pet each (i.e., two (2) pets in total) in Business, an additional seat shall be purchased for each pet.

o   Where an additional seat has been purchased, the passenger is entitled to the additional checked baggage allowance associated with the purchased seat.

  • Where possible, the guest travelling with a pet should be allocated a window seat. A guest travelling with a pet will not be seated in any of the following locations:

o   Bulkhead rows

o   Emergency exit rows

o   One row forward and aft of over-wing exit rows

  • Standard Seat will be provided free of charge for a guest travelling with a pet (SSR PETC) within 48 hours of departure.
  • Guests must submit the booking form at least 7 days in advance and provide all necessary documents to the Contact Centre no later than 72 hours prior to intended travel. Where three (3) pets will be carried as permitted, a separate form must be completed for each pet
  • SSR PETC can be updated in the booking only by EY agents and it must be updated only after receiving all approvals
  • For guests using the Etihad Chauffeur service, or connecting Etihad Shuttle services in the UAE, pets are permitted on these services in accordance with this policy
  • For guests eligible to use premium lounges, pets may be taken into Etihad lounges in Abu Dhabi. For lounges in network airports, access is dependent upon the acceptance policy of the lounge operator. Pets must always remain inside the pet carrier or kennel

 

Booking Process

Note: SSR "PETC" can only be updated by Etihad once the documents are received and approved

  1. Complete & submit the booking form, at least seven days prior to travel & email supporting documents no later than 72 hours before the flight to pets@etihad.ae
  2. For travel to Abu Dhabi, a UAE Health Certificate form needs to be completed. This must be signed & stamped by a government-accredited health official from the country of departure, within five days of the flight departure
  3. If Abu Dhabi is the final destination, it is compulsory to apply for a release permit 
  4. Acceptance will only be granted once all the necessary health documents & important licenses have been obtained
  5. Acceptance from pets@etihad.ae along with the original documents will be required for verification at the airport 

 

Anyone travelling to Abu Dhabi with a pet or service dog must obtain an Abu Dhabi Customs Bill of Entry document at least 24 hours before their departure. To receive it, you need to submit the following documents to NOATUM Logistics:

o   UAE residents: Emirates ID copy

o   Non-residents: passport copy 

o   An import permit for your pet or service dog 

o   Your mobile number 

o   A copy of your reservation or ticket

 

NOATUM Logistics will review your information and email you the Bill of Entry, which costs AED 365.

 

How much does it cost?

The rates for carrying a pet cat or dog:

 

 Economy

  • It costs USD 399 or 50,000 Etihad Guest Miles for each way to travel with a cat or dog in Economy

  • If guests are transiting, the combined price of USD 798 or 100,000 Etihad Guest Miles will apply

  • If an adjacent seat booking is requested, it must be done in advance, and guests will be charged for the cost of an extra seat plus USD 399 each way

  • If an additional seat is purchased for a pet, then guests are entitled to the additional check baggage allowance associated with the purchased seat

 

Business

  • As there is no space available under the seat, guests must purchase an extra seat for their pet

  • This must be booked in advance and the guest will be charged for the cost of an extra seat plus USD 399 each way

  • Guests are entitled to the additional check baggage allowance associated with the purchased seat

 

To pay using Etihad Guest Miles, please call us.  

 

Terms & Conditions:

- Etihad Airways will not be responsible if authorities in other countries refuse entry of your pet due to non-compliance with local regulations. Etihad will in this case, not be liable for any resulting costs such as flight rebooking charges, hotel accommodation if Etihad have to refuse the carriage of your pet due to non-compliance with the regulations

- We assume no liability for the health or wellbeing of pets carried in the cabin

- The pet must be able to sit and stand in a natural position with its head fully erect (without touching the roof), turn around and lie down

- The carrier must be ventilated on at least three (3) surfaces

- The carrier must be escape-proof (rigid door for kennels or secure entrance for pet travel bag) and leak-proof

- The container floor must contain absorbent material.

- Guests are responsible for additional costs for import or export.

- Pregnant pets cannot be accepted for travel.

- Guests must report 3 hours prior to departure at the airport.

- Guest must bring enough of absorbent sheets for your pet to relieve itself, including connecting flights and transit airport, if applicable

- Guest can only carry dry pet food in your cabin baggage. Food should be carried in a sealed container so the smell does not disturb other guests

- If there are guests travelling on-board that are allergic to animals, our crew may be required to re-seat you and your pet. In rare occurrences, we may need to re-book your flight

- Sedation of animals, except under certain conditions and carried out under veterinary supervision, is not recommended. Commonly used tranquilizers lower blood pressure, which also occurs at high altitude

- The combination of high altitude and medicines could be dangerous for old, chronically sick or stressed animals. Keeping a container in a dark, cool, quiet place prior to flying will calm down most animals. If you have to sedate your pet per veterinarian’s instruction, the name of the drug and time of intake must be clearly marked on the container

- Guests must complete all formalities upon arrival at Abu Dhabi airport according to UAE regulations, including an inspection by the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) veterinary officer, performed in the Customs clearance area.

- For all other destinations, guests must complete all arrival formalities according to local regulations.

- Inspection and clearance areas may vary from airport to airport, guests must check with the applicable authority at their destination for specific requirements.

 

Changes and Refunds:

Voluntary changes: The guest can change the request anytime up to 3 hours to departure time. However, if the guest wishes to take the pet on the new dates/flight, they’d need to inform Etihad Airways and go through the approval process again. The guest will still be liable of ensuring that the required documents, certificates, permits allow for the pet to travel on the rebooked flight.  The same process applies to guests who wish to upgrade their ticket to a higher class of travel. 

 

Involuntary changes: Etihad Airways will coordinate with the guest and provide the best available options in cases where the flight has been re-booked or cancelled. For delays or flight cancellations, the guest may utilize the original animal documentation.

 

Refunds: A full refund is only given for cases where Etihad had an irregular operation and was not able to transport the pet. In this case, the guest can reach out to our contact centers and request for a refund to the fees that were paid. - Pets are permitted to be carried in Economy and Business cabins only. Pets cannot be carried in the First cabin and The Residence.

- Pets are permitted on direct EY routes to, from or via Abu Dhabi on EY marketed (607 stock) and operated flights

- These are only bookable through Etihad Contact Centres

- Guests must be at least 18 years of age to be eligible to transport a pet.

- It is permitted for a guest to bring one (1) cat or one (1) dog as a pet in the cabin

Note: Each pet must be in a separate travel kennel crate.

 

- On a flight with falcons(s) travelling in the cabin, a pet (dog or cat) cannot travel in the same travel cabin as the falcon(s). If a guest is travelling with a pet dog or cat in the cabin and another guest is travelling with a falcon in the same class on the same flight, the request of the guest who made the first reservation shall be confirmed.

- Where a guest with an allergy statement and a guest with a pet request are travelling on the same flight, the request of the guest who made the first reservation will be confirmed.

- If a guest travelling with a pet dog or cat in the cabin and a guest travelling with a trained service animal is on the same flight, the request of the guest wishing to travel with a trained service animal will always take priority regardless of time of reservation.

- The container (pet travel bag or kennel) must be within the maximum weight and dimension requirements for the applicable travel class (refer to sections 3.1 and 3.2) and must meet the following requirements:

o The pet should be able to sit and stand in a natural position with its head fully erect (without touching the roof), turn around and lie down

o The carrier must be ventilated on at least three (3) surfaces

o The carrier must be escape-proof (rigid door for kennels / secure entrance for pet travel bag) and leak proof

o The container floor must contain absorbent material

- The guest will provide:

o Absorbent material for inside the container, including sufficient spares and disposal bags

o Dry food in a sealed container for the animal, sufficient for the duration of the journey.

- The pet must not be allowed outside the pet travel bag or kennel whilst on board the aircraft.

- The pet must be of a minimum of 16 weeks old.

- In Economy Cabin,

o For under-seat carriage, the pet must be able to fit in a pet travel bag or kennel with maximum dimensions of 40 x 40 x 22 cm (L x W x H) to fit safely under the seat.

o For carriage on an adjacent purchased seat, the pet must be able to fit in a pet travel bag or kennel with maximum dimensions of 50 x 43 x 50 cm (L x W x H).

o The pet travel bag or kennel shall be secured to the seat with extension seat belts.

o The gross weight (pet and travel bag/kennel combined) should be no more than 8 kg.

- In Business Cabin,

o It is not possible to stow pets under seats.

o An extra seat must be purchased adjacent to the accompanying guest and the pet shall be in a pet travel bag or kennel with maximum dimensions of 50 x 43 x 50 cm (L x W x H).

o Contact Centre agent must ensure that there are adjacent seats available on the aircraft and block them before accepting the carriage of pet request. If there are no adjacent seats, an alternate flight must be offered.

o The gross weight (pet and travel bag/kennel combined) must not be more than 8 kg.

o Where two (2) passengers travelling together wish to bring one (1) pet each (i.e., two (2) pets in total) in Business, an additional seat shall be purchased for each pet.

o Where an additional seat has been purchased, the passenger is entitled to the additional checked baggage allowance associated with the purchased seat.

- Where possible, the guest travelling with a pet should be allocated a window seat. A guest travelling with a pet will not be seated in any of the following locations:

o Bulkhead rows

o Emergency exit rows

o One row forward and aft of over-wing exit rows

- Standard Seat will be provided free of charge for a guest travelling with a pet (SSR PETC) within 48 hours of departure.

- Guests must submit the booking form at least 7 days in advance and provide all necessary documents to the Contact Centre no later than 72 hours prior to intended travel. Where three (3) pets will be carried as permitted, a separate form must be completed for each pet

- SSR PETC can be updated in the booking only by EY agents and it must be updated only after receiving all approvals

- For guests using the Etihad Chauffeur service, or connecting Etihad Shuttle services in the UAE, pets are permitted on these services in accordance with this policy

- For guests eligible to use premium lounges, pets may be taken into Etihad lounges in Abu Dhabi. For lounges in network airports, access is dependent upon the acceptance policy of the lounge operator. Pets must always remain inside the pet carrier or kennel

 

Booking Process

Note: SSR "PETC" can only be updated by Etihad once the documents are received and approved

- Complete & submit the booking form, at least seven days prior to travel & email supporting documents no later than 72 hours before the flight to pets@etihad.ae

- For travel to Abu Dhabi, a UAE Health Certificate form needs to be completed. This must be signed & stamped by a government-accredited health official from the country of departure, within five days of the flight departure

- If Abu Dhabi is the final destination, it is compulsory to apply for a release permit 

- Acceptance will only be granted once all the necessary health documents & important licenses have been obtained

- Acceptance from pets@etihad.ae along with the original documents will be required for verification at the airport 

 

Anyone travelling to Abu Dhabi with a pet or service dog must obtain an Abu Dhabi Customs Bill of Entry document at least 24 hours before their departure. To receive it, you need to submit the following documents to NOATUM Logistics:

o UAE residents: Emirates ID copy

o Non-residents: passport copy 

o An import permit for your pet or service dog 

o Your mobile number 

o A copy of your reservation or ticket

 

NOATUM Logistics will review your information and email you the Bill of Entry, which costs AED 365.

 

How much does it cost?

The rates for carrying a pet cat or dog:

 

 Economy

- 
It costs USD 399 or 50,000 Etihad Guest Miles for each way to travel with a cat or dog in Economy

- 
If guests are transiting, the combined price of USD 798 or 100,000 Etihad Guest Miles will apply

- 
If an adjacent seat booking is requested, it must be done in advance, and guests will be charged for the cost of an extra seat plus USD 399 each way

- 
If an additional seat is purchased for a pet, then guests are entitled to the additional check baggage allowance associated with the purchased seat

 

Business

- 
As there is no space available under the seat, guests must purchase an extra seat for their pet

- 
This must be booked in advance and the guest will be charged for the cost of an extra seat plus USD 399 each way

- 
Guests are entitled to the additional check baggage allowance associated with the purchased seat

 

To pay using Etihad Guest Miles, please call us.

Etihad will in this case, not be liable for any resulting costs such as flight rebooking charges, hotel accommodation if Etihad have to refuse the carriage of your pet due to non-compliance with the regulations

- Guests must report 3 hours prior to departure at the airport.

- Guest must bring enough of absorbent sheets for your pet to relieve itself, including connecting flights and transit airport, if applicable

- Guest can only carry dry pet food in your cabin baggage. Food should be carried in a sealed container so the smell does not disturb other guests

- If there are guests travelling on-board that are allergic to animals, our crew may be required to re-seat you and your pet. In rare occurrences, we may need to re-book your flight

- Sedation of animals, except under certain conditions and carried out under veterinary supervision, is not recommended. Commonly used tranquilizers lower blood pressure, which also occurs at high altitude

- The combination of high altitude and medicines could be dangerous for old, chronically sick or stressed animals. Keeping a container in a dark, cool, quiet place prior to flying will calm down most animals. If you have to sedate your pet per veterinarian’s instruction, the name of the drug and time of intake must be clearly marked on the container

records.title: The Residence
records.html:
The Residence provides the ultimate luxury experience in the sky, offering a three-room suite designed by top interior designers and hospitality experts. The living room features a double seat sofa, ottoman, dining table, drinks cabinet and a 32-inch flat screen TV. A soft carpeted hallway leads to your private bathroom with ensuite shower, where you can immerse yourself in exclusive toiletries and sink into plush bathrobes. The bedroom is decorated with delicate fabrics and furnished with a neutral fibre mattress double bed, Egyptian cotton sheets and a selection of pillows for your comfort. Our dedicated team will also be available throughout the flight to cater to your every need. 

 

The Residence can be booked through the following channels: 

  • - Etihad Airways website 
  • - Etihad Airways contact centre 
  • - Etihad Reservation and Ticketing offices 
  • - NDC 

 

To book The Residence, you can initially book guests in First (RBDs F&A) and contact one of the available channels for an upgrade. This is valid on Etihad Airways-operated flights for a maximum of two guests, including one infant, who can be booked on the same PNR.  

 

If an infant is the second passenger, an approved car seat can be carried as The Residence does not have a bassinet, otherwise the infant must travel on the adult’s lap. There is no child or infant discount, and both passengers must be on the same PNR to book for two. 

 

For any group bookings where one or two members want to travel in The Residence, then the PNR must be split. Afterwards, The Residence process must be followed.   

 

Single booking PNRs can only be upgraded to add an additional guest before the travel date. To include the additional guest, you must first cancel the original booking and create a new one that includes two guests. This will not be possible on the travel date or after travel has commenced. 

 

 There is an Automatic Issuance Limit of one hour for The Residence ancillary and standard processes must be followed for chauffeur services. 

 

Changes 

If a guest wants to rebook The Residence on another date, this can be done through our contact centre if it's available on the changed date. In case The Residence isn't available on the new date, the EMD can be refunded back to the original FOP. 

 

Refund 

Full refunds on The Residence bookings may be processed before departure. However, in case of no shows, the EMD is non-refundable. First tickets will be refunded according to Etihad’s fare rules. 

If a guest cancels a booking in The Residence, then they may be rebooked in First subject to seat availability. 

If The Residence is not provided to the guest due to involuntary reasons, the EMD can be refunded free of charge.

 

FAQs

1. Can changes be made on the day of departure for free?

Yes, changes are permitted free of charge on the day of departure.

 

2. Is this ancillary service filed in USD regardless of origin?

Yes, it’s filed in USD and then converted to the payment currency. 

 

3. Can one adult carry two infants provided they bring a car seat? Can the car seat be strapped on to the seat in The Residence?  

For safety reasons, only one infant or child is allowed to travel with an adult in The Residence. If the second passenger is an infant, a car seat approved for air travel may be used. 

 

4.  Is it possible to add one more guest to stay in The Residence apart from the two initial guests?

It’s not possible to accommodate more than two guests in The Residence due to safety regulations, which mandate that the bedroom is limited to two guests and the seating area is limited to two persons during taxi, take-off and landing.

records.title: UK Air Passenger Duty (APD or GB tax)
records.html:
Young guests under 16 years of age travelling in Economy from a UK airport do not have to pay UK Air Passenger Duty (APD or GB tax). This tax exemption is automatic for infant and child fares.

  

Policy

Children under the age of 16 travelling in economy class from a UK airport are not subject to APD (GB).

 

Agents should ensure that APD does not apply to these cases prior to ticketing and exemption if they meet the eligibility requirements below:

-The guest is aged between 12 and 16 at the time of travel (before their 16th birthday).

- The flight is from a UK airport

- The guest is travelling in economy class

records.title: Codeshare
records.html:
Code sharing is a marketing agreement where an airline places its designator code on a flight operated by another airline and sells tickets for that flight. 

 

If two or more airlines publish and market the same flight as part of their published timetable or schedule, they will do so using their respective airline designator (airline flight code). This type of commercial agreement is known as a codeshare agreement or simply as a codeshare. 

 

Policy

1) Reserving seats:

a. All guests travelling in Economy and Business class can reserve seats using the seat map available for Amadeus hosted carriers.

b. Guests travelling in Business class can make a general seat request (SSR SEAT) on non-Amadeus hosted carriers. 

 

2) Special Services Request (SSR):

a. SSR UMNR, STCR, EXST, CBBG etc. are not permitted on codeshare flights

b. SSR CHLD, INFANT & Contact SSRs (CTCM, CTCE, CTCH) are the only SSRs accepted for reservations on Air Arabia (3L). No other SSRs are permitted.

 

3) Changes: 

a. Tickets must be reissued when a change is made to a booking. 

 

4) Schedule change:

a. All “schedule changed” PNRs fall into the queue of the respective booking office. It is the responsibility of the booking agent to action these bookings.

b. For Amadeus hosted airlines, ticket revalidation is permitted only in the event of "schedule changes”. This is automated. For all other GDS hosted carriers, the ticket must be reissued.

c. It is the responsibility of the disrupting carrier to re-book the guest on next available flight from origin to destination, when the change is within the DCS window i.e. within 72hrs prior to departure. Codeshare team has no visibility of the changes. Agents must follow the disruption policy if the operating carrier has not provided alternates. 

 

5) UN/UC/NO status codes:

a. Itineraries with UN/UC/NO status codes must be rebooked on the next available connection according to the policy.

 

6) Group Bookings:

a .Group Bookings are not permitted on Codeshare flights.

 

7) Ancillaries: 

iEMD is available on blockspace flights operated by Akasa Airlines (QP) and Air Seychelles (HM). Guests will be able to purchase Seats and Extra baggage for travel on/after 29 January 2026. 

  

The ancillaries will be available for purchase through direct channels. 

  

Booking Timeframes 

 

    ⦁ Seat selection will be available up to 72 hours before departure 

 

 

    ⦁ Extra baggage will be available up to 4 hours before departure 

 

  

Important Notes 

    ⦁ Standard Etihad ancillary rules will apply

Code sharing is a marketing agreement where an airline places its designator code on a flight operated by another airline and sells tickets for that flight. 

 

If two or more airlines publish and market the same flight as part of their published timetable or schedule, they will do so using their respective airline designator (airline flight code). This type of commercial agreement is known as a codeshare agreement or simply as a codeshare. 

 

Policy

1) Reserving seats:

a. All guests travelling in Economy and Business class can reserve seats using the seat map available for Amadeus hosted carriers.

b. Guests travelling in Business class can make a general seat request (SSR SEAT) on non-Amadeus hosted carriers. 

 

2) Special Services Request (SSR):

a. SSR UMNR, STCR, EXST, CBBG etc. are not permitted on codeshare flights

b. SSR CHLD, INFANT & Contact SSRs (CTCM, CTCE, CTCH) are the only SSRs accepted for reservations on Air Arabia (3L). No other SSRs are permitted.

 

3) Changes: 

a. Tickets must be reissued when a change is made to a booking. 

 

4) Schedule change:

a. All “schedule changed” PNRs fall into the queue of the respective booking office. It is the responsibility of the booking agent to action these bookings.

b. For Amadeus hosted airlines, ticket revalidation is permitted only in the event of "schedule changes”. This is automated. For all other GDS hosted carriers, the ticket must be reissued.

c. It is the responsibility of the disrupting carrier to re-book the guest on next available flight from origin to destination, when the change is within the DCS window i.e. within 72hrs prior to departure. Codeshare team has no visibility of the changes. Agents must follow the disruption policy if the operating carrier has not provided alternates. 

 

5) UN/UC/NO status codes:

a. Itineraries with UN/UC/NO status codes must be rebooked on the next available connection according to the policy.

 

6) Group Bookings:

a .Group Bookings are not permitted on Codeshare flights.

 

7) Ancillaries: 

iEMD is available on blockspace flights operated by Akasa Airlines (QP) and Air Seychelles (HM). Guests will be able to purchase Seats and Extra baggage for travel on/after 29 January 2026. 

  

The ancillaries will be available for purchase through direct channels. 

  

Booking Timeframes 

 

 ⦁ Seat selection will be available up to 72 hours before departure 

 

 

 ⦁ Extra baggage will be available up to 4 hours before departure 

 

  

Important Notes 

 ⦁ Standard Etihad ancillary rules will apply

records.title: Interline Ticketing
records.html:
Interline agreements between airlines make travel faster and more convenient for guests who may need to take multiple flights on more than one airline to reach their final destination. 

 

These agreements allow guests to travel on various airline networks on a single booking.

 

The key advantages of an Interline agreement are:

- Offers guests more destination options.

- The convenience of a single reservation.

- Gives guests the peace of mind that their itineraries include adequate time for connecting flights.

- Boarding passes and checked baggage to the final destination of the guests.

 

Types of Agreements

- Unilateral Interline Agreement: An agreement that allows only one airline to sell the flights of another airline using its own ticket stock.

- Bilateral Interline Agreement: An agreement that allows both airlines to sell each other’s flights on their own ticket stock.

- Multilateral Agreement: An agreement where passengers and cargo use a standard traffic document (i.e. a ticket or airway bill) to travel on multiple forms of transport involved in a routing to reach a final destination.

 

Guidelines

- Reservations must be made directly with the operating airline for unaccompanied minors (UMNR) and group bookings.

- Passive and Open segments are not permitted.

- Ticket revalidation is not permitted.

- Exchange from paper ticket to e-ticket is not permitted.

- When booking a journey on Air Arabia Abu Dhabi (3L codeshare) at least one EY prime air segment must be present directionally (Etihad Shuttle bookings are not permitted in the combination).

- Travel Agent PNRs/bookings must be amended by the booking source only. Etihad Airways will not take control if booked as an Interline. This applies to schedule changes as well. 

 

Interline Partner Table

records.title: 24 Hours Cooling-off Period Policy
records.html:
The “24 Hours Cooling off Period” policy allows guests to:

 

1)Hold a reservation with guaranteed fare quote (applies to POS US and Canada only):

A stored fare quote is guaranteed for 24 hours from the time of booking provided following conditions are met:

- First flight segment on the itinerary must be at least 7 days in advance

- Advance purchase (AP) conditions of fares must be followed

- Ticket time limit (TTL) conditions of fares must be followed

Agents must ensure that they update endorsement of the ticket with “C24” for audit and tracking purposes.  

 

2)Cancelling a paid reservation:

Agent may cancel their ticketed booking free of charge if the following conditions are met:

- Applies to all point-of-sales.

- Applicable only for new bookings/original ticket.

- Ticket is purchased at least 7 days before the departure date.

- Refund requests must be submitted within 24 hours of ticket issuance.

- Additionally, a ticket purchased in India may be cancelled without penalty within the 48 hours of issuance, provided the departure is at least 15 days away for international flights. 

 

All fare rules have been updated to automatically apply the policy for cancellations within 24/48 hours.  

 

Waiver code C24 must be used to indicate the override. For refunds, the code must be updated as a historical remark in the PNR.

 

New bookings

Every guest must be made aware of Etihad’s 24 or 48 hour cooling off policy at the time of booking. Make sure to update the PNR with “Guest advised of 24 or 48 hour policy”. 

 

Changes

Not permitted and C24 will apply only for refunds.

Exception: For POS India only, tickets can be changed “Free of Charge” if it is issued for travel 15 days or more in advance of departure and within 48 hours of ticket issuance.

To reissue a ticket, the waiver must be applied manually and the code (C24) must be entered in the tour code box. Any difference in fare must be settled by the guest.

Name correction is not included. 

 

Refunds

Cancelled tickets can be fully refunded within 24 hours of being issued, so long as the ticket has been issued for travel at least seven days in advance. Additionally, a ticket purchased in India may be cancelled without penalty within the 48 hours of issuance, provided the departure is at least 15 days away for international flights.

Payments must be refunded to the original form of payment and processed within 24 hours.

 

Always enter the code C24 in:

⦁   Tour code box when the ticket is reissued

⦁   Remarks in PNR when the refund is processed through GDS

⦁   Remarks in PNR when the refund is applied through the BSP link (refunds through BSP must be applied within 24 hours of the ticket being issued)

*Same code applies for POS India where 48 hours flexibility is applied. 

 

Follow the below rules if you need to refund non-refundable taxes with C24:

Booking Fee (GSF/ OB fee) charged at the time of ticket issuance will be non-refundable.

 

Refunds may take at least seven working days to be credited.

records.title: Return date out of system range
records.html:
Introduction

For dates of return travel that fall beyond 360 days in the future.

 

Policy

  • Guests can book tickets with Etihad Airways up to 360 days in the future

  • If their journey includes onward or inbound dates that fall outside the 360-day limit from their original booking date, then guests can change one date free of charge once those dates become available in the booking system

     

The text below shall be added in the CAT16 rule data for such fares:

ONE DATE CHANGE PERMITTED FOC WHEN RETURN DATE OUT OF RANGE. RETURN DATE MUST BE SPECIFIED AT TIME OF ORIGINAL BOOKING. IF ORIGINAL RBD IS NOT AVAILABLE THEN ANY FARE DIFFERENCE SHALL APPLY.

 

Procedure

Reservation and Ticketing Agents need to book the last available date in the system and add a remark in the PNR with the traveller’s return date agreed at the time of booking. The return date can be changed to the pre-notified date when it becomes available, within booking range and in the same RBD free of charge (FOC). Fare differences will apply if any other date is booked and/or the original RBD not used or available. You must advise the guest accordingly at the time of original booking.

records.title: Change to IATA Resolution.735d
records.html:
From 1 June 2019, changes will be made to the IATA Resolution 735d policy which governs Involuntary Change of Carrier, Routing, Class or Type of Fare. The main changes are:

 

  • Resolution 735d only applies when the circumstance that results in an involuntary reroute occurs a maximum of one day before the scheduled departure time of the first impacted flight. 
  • A change to the passenger’s itinerary as originally ticketed may involve a change to the routing, arrival or departure dates or times, or carriers. Resolution 735d may apply even if there is no change in carrier.
  • Upgrading to a higher cabin class shall not occur unless specifically permitted by the New Operating Carrier as bilaterally agreed with the Original Operating Carrier
  • The characters ‘INVOL’ must be used in the first five characters of the endorsement/restriction area of the reissued document only where an Involuntary Reroute has occurred. The characters ‘INVOL’ shall not be used in the endorsement area of the reissued document in any other circumstances such as schedule changes.
  • Where an Original Operating Carrier obtains inventory from a New Operating Carrier as described in Resolution 735d, the New Operating Carrier should accept and transport the customer, provided that the bilaterally agreed booking method has been used for obtaining inventory.
  •  

Find details of the changes here. 

 

Involuntary Flight Changes FAQ

records.title: Ticket validity
records.html:
Introduction:

This document aims to explain the definition of validity of a Virtual Coupon Record (VCR), or ticket.

 

Policy  

Except as otherwise provided in the Virtual Coupon Record (VCR) or in applicable fare rules (which may limit the validity of a ticket, in which case the limitation will be shown on the ticket), a VCR, or ticket, is valid for:

 

1)    One year from the date of issue of the original ticket, if completely unused. For instance, if a guest issues a return ticket on 29 March 2016, they must commence their outbound travel before 29 March 2017.

 

2)    One year from the date of first outbound travel provided the outbound travel has commenced within one year from the date of issue of the original VCR. For instance, if a ticket is issued on 29 March 2016 and the guest has travelled outbound on 29 March 2017, they must return before 27 March 2018.

 

3)    Reissuance of a fully unused ticket does not change the validity: the validity of the original ticket applies. For instance, if a guest issues a return ticket on 29 March 2016, and reissues the ticket on 30 March 2016, they must commence their outbound travel before 29 March 2017 and return before 29 March 2018. The date of issue of the original ticket is always shown on the reissued ticket.

 

One-year validity shall mean one year from the date of issue or the date of commencement of travel, as applicable, to the corresponding date in the subsequent year (unless specified differently in fare rules).

 

Exception:

In case the guest is denied boarding at the airport because they are deemed unfit for travel, then the below policy shall apply:

 

If, after having commenced carriage, a guest is prevented from travelling within the validity period of their ticket or VCR because of illness, the validity may be extended until the date when the guest becomes fit to travel or until the first flight after such date from the point where the journey is resumed, on which space is available in the class of service for which the fare has been paid. Such illness must be attested to by a medical certificate. When the flight coupons remaining in the VCR or ticket involve one or more stopovers, the validity may be extended for up to three months from the date shown on the certificate. In such circumstances, we will similarly extend the period of validity of tickets of other members of immediate family accompanying the guest.

 

In the event of death of a guest en-route, the tickets of accompanying guests may be modified by Etihad Airways either by waiving the minimum stay or extending the validity. In the event of a death in the immediate family of a guest who has commenced carriage, the validity of the VCR or ticket and those of the immediate family* who are accompanying the guest may likewise be modified. Any such modification shall be made upon receipt of a valid death certificate or other evidence satisfactory to Etihad Airways and any such extension of validity shall not be for a period longer than forty-five (45) days from the date of the death.

 

*Immediate family member - spouse, parents (including stepparents), children (including adopted and stepchildren), siblings, grandparents, grandchildren, fathers-in-law, mothers-in-law, brothers-in-law, sisters-in-law, sons-in-law, and daughters-in-law.

records.title: Protection of onward travel in case of no-show
records.html:
Policy

 

No-show guests are permitted to travel on their onward flight without any change in fare provided they inform Etihad Airways within 24 hours of the scheduled departure time of the unused flight.

 

Guests must be travelling on tickets sold in Europe, Russia or the UK through Etihad.com, ticket offices, Etihad Contact Centre or Travel Agencies.

 

If the departure time of the next flight is within 24 hours, please inform us at least two hours before the departure time of the next flight. Failure to do so will result in the remaining reservations being cancelled. If the guest wishes to rebook, subject to availability of seats, they will be charged the difference between the original ticket and the highest fare in the same class of travel, applicable to the modified itinerary at the time that the ticket is reissued. If the fare rules of the original ticket are more favourable to the guest, they will be applied.

 

PNR remarks and ticket endorsement must be updated with “CW136 PROTECTION OF ONWARD TRAVEL”.

 

 Get in touch with Etihad.

records.title: Refunds
records.html:
Introduction

Automated Refund (AER) allows the refund of sale documents such as paper tickets, Virtual Coupon Records (VCR), Miscellaneous Charges Order (MCO), Vouchers and Electronic Miscellaneous Document (EMD).

 

 

Policy

1) When combining two different Etihad fares, the highest or most restrictive refund penalty applies.

 
2) When a non-refundable fare is combined with a refundable fare, the whole ticket is non-refundable.

 
3) If an EY (607) ticket is issued using a combination of EY and OAL fares, the respective refund fare rules apply (not the most restrictive rule). If the OAL ticket is non-refundable, then a refund will only apply for the EY parts of the ticket based on EY's rules. This uses mileage proration.

 

4) For reissued tickets, the refund penalties of the original ticket and reissued ticket will be compared, and the highest of the two will be applied. If the original ticket is non-refundable, the base fare + YQ/YR (where applicable) will be considered as the refund penalty for comparison. 

For example: If the non-refundable amount of the original ticket is AED500 and the standard refund penalty of the reissued ticket is AED100, a penalty of AED500 will be deducted at the time of refund. This is automatically calculated by ATC.

 

5) For non-refundable tickets, only the applicable government taxes are refunded. Fuel surcharge (YQ/YR) is non-refundable for such tickets - except for tickets issued in UK, Germany, Ireland, Netherlands, Luxembourg and Nordic countries (Denmark, Finland, Norway, Iceland and Sweden and their associated territories, the Faroe Islands, Greenland and Aland). Penalties, service fees and insurance are non-refundable.

Follow the below rules if you need to refund non-refundable taxes:

Country

Tax Code

Remarks

Egypt

XL

Non-Refundable after ticket issuance

Q7

Non-Refundable after ticket issuance

S4

Non-Refundable after ticket issuance

Saudi Arabia

E3

Non-Refundable after ticket issuance

Philippines

PH

Non-Refundable after 30 days of ticket issuance. Can be refunded while applying C24

US

US/ZP/XF

Non-Refundable for non-refundable fares, but can be refunded while applying C24 or schedule change

India

K3

K3 tax to be refunded provided the request is made within the cut off dates for the financial year. Financial year is on/after 01April of a given year to on/before 31March of the following year. Refund cut off will be 31October of the same year. This is applicable for involuntary refunds and refunds to Voucher/Wallet as well.

E.g.: For tickets issued during the financial year 01 April 2022 - 31 March 2023, K3 tax refund will be allowed till 31 Oct 2023.

Pakistan

N9

Non-Refundable after ticket issuance

Jordan

O7

Non-Refundable after ticket issuance

Dominican Republic

L8

Non-Refundable after ticket issuance

Lebanon

YL

Non-Refundable, but can be refunded while using C24

Portugal

J9

Non-refundable for non-refundable fares, but can be refunded while applying C24 or schedule change

Booking Fee (GSF/ OB fee) charged at the time of ticket issuance will be non-refundable.

 

6) Some government taxes are non-refundable after sale. Refer to tax rules on respective GDS.

 

7) Ticket coupons cannot be refunded if used out of sequence.

 

8) Refunds are processed to the same form of payment used for issuing the ticket/ EMD.

 

9) Refund validity:

  • Completely unused tickets - One year from the date of issue of the original ticket.
    Example: A return ticket issued on 29 June 2022, must be refunded on or before 29 June 2023.

 

  • Partially Used tickets - One year from the date of the first outbound travel provided that the outbound travel has commenced within one year from the date of issue of the original ticket. Example: A ticket is issued on 29 March 2022 the guest travelled outbound on 27 March 2023, it can be refunded on or before 27 March 2024.

 

The one-year validity period starts from the ticket's issue or travel start date until the same date the following year, unless stated otherwise.

 

10) Air segments must be cancelled after processing the refund.

 

11) Update corporate remarks with the reason for cancellation (for involuntary refunds).

 

12) A no-show fee is automatically applied by the system when a refund is processed, and it depends on the date on the ticket coupon. This means that even if the itinerary is cancelled before departure, the system recognises it as a no-show if the ticket is not exchanged for a new date.

 
13) A refund penalty is automatically applied on base fare + fuel surcharge (YQ) by the system according to fare filing when a refund is processed.

 

14) When refund penalty is more than refundable base fare + YQ, only the base fare + YQ must be retained. Unutilised refundable government taxes must be refund in full.

 

15) Refund must be calculated by deducting the one-way fare for the journey traveled in the same RBD and fare brand plus the refund penalty from the fare paid. If one-way fare is not available in the same RBD and fare brand or if the one-way fare is lower than ½ RT of the flown RBD and brand, the one-way fare of the next higher RBD and fare brand must be used.

 

16) The Rate of Exchange (ROE) applied for refunds is based on the exchange rate which was in effect on the date of original ticket issuance. 

 

17) Refunds cannot be voided once they're processed.

 

18) In the unfortunate event of a death, travel agencies must submit an email request to the nearest Sales Office in the area. If the waiver is granted, a token number will be issued. The travel agent must then update this number in the BSP application along with the refund request.

 

Waiver of cancellation fee is provided only in case of death of guest or immediate family member. A valid death certificate must be provided as proof. Guest’s immediate family members (spouse, parents including stepparents, children including adopted and stepchildren, siblings, grandparents, grandchildren, fathers-in-law, mothers-in-law, brothers-in-law, sisters-in-law, sons-in-law, and daughters-in-law) can claim for a refund with proof of relationship to the deceased. Proof can be a passport copy or a government issued identity card that states the relationship. Please make guests aware that all documents submitted must be in English or translated into English.

 

Credit Card Refund Policy

Credit card refunds can take between 5 and 14 days to appear on the guest’s account.

records.title: Name correction
records.html:
There are a number of reasons why you may need to update or change a name. For example, a guest has provided a different name to that shown on their passport, your guest has got married and changed their surname, or the spelling of their name was misunderstood by the booking agent.

 

Policy

1) Etihad Airways accepts request for name correction for a ticketed booking before or after commencement of travel for the following reasons:

Reason

Example

Chargeable

Genuine typing errors up to 3 characters

TOM/JIRRY MR to TOM/JERRY MR

No

Title Amendments

TOM/MARY MR to TOM/MARY MRS

No

Rearranging Surname/First Name

MARY/TOM MRS to TOM/MARY MRS or MARY TOM/FNU MRS

No

Maiden Name to Married Name (or vice versa)

JOHN/MARY MS TO JACK/MARY MRS

Yes

Shortened/Nick name to full name

ALSHAMSI/MOHD MR to ALSHAMSI/MOHAMMED MR

Yes

Addition/Deletion of Middle name* 

BROWN/JOHN MR to BROWN/JOHN PAUL MR

Yes

Addition/Deletion of Surname* 

PAUL/JOHN MR to BROWN/JOHN PAUL MR

Yes

Addition of suffix (Jr,Sr,II,III etc,) 

PAUL/JOHN to PAUL/JOHN JR 

Yes

Complete/partial name change for the same guest with proof from authorities (e.g., Deed Poll)

GEORGE/PAUL MR to DANIEL/JACK MR

Yes

*Both Surname and Middle name should be present in the passport. Middle name is not mandatory even when travelling to/from US and Canada.

 

2) Title amendments, juxtaposing/rearranging surname/first name and name corrections due to genuine typing errors (up to three characters) are accepted free of charge.  Name correction that results in an entire name change is not permitted (e.g. Harry to Garry).

 

3) The name correction fee does not apply to partially used tickets. If a guest has already travelled in one direction, there is no additional charge for name correction mid-journey. If a name change is needed to meet local regulatory requirements for the return trip, the amendment will be free of charge.

 

4) Any other correction will only be permitted if it's listed above and it will incur a fee of US $100 or AU $150 if purchased in Australia.

 

5) The request must be for the same guest on the ticket.

 

6) Only one change is permitted per guest.

 

7) Name corrections are not permitted for un-ticketed bookings. A new booking must be created with the correct name in the available booking class.  If the name correction is made on an un-ticketed booking, it will be identified through the Revenue Integrity Name Change Violation Process and cancelled.

 

8) Travel agents must contact Etihad Airways Contact Centre for name correction on ticketed bookings. If they attempt to make any corrections, the booking may get cancelled automatically.

 

9) After correcting the name on the booking, tickets must be reissued to match the corrected name. Travel agents can reissue the ticket to keep control of the ticket. Alternatively, Etihad Airways Contact Centre can reissue the ticket, but this will incur a Global Service Fee (GSF).

 

10) If a travel agent attempts to make a name correction to a ticketed booking, it will be identified and cancelled by Revenue Integrity Name change violation process.

 

11) To make a name correction or change on group bookings, there is a fee of USD100 or AU $150 if purchased in Australia.

 

12) Name corrections are permitted on Etihad Airways tickets (607) with Other Airline (OAL) segments. A new booking must be created, and the ticket has to be reissued. 

 

13)  For NDC bookings, the system will automatically truncate long names to fit within the 59-character limit. This can heavily truncate infant names, causing issues at the airport. In such cases, it is permitted to update the infant's name with more characters and remove a few characters from the adult's name. The name correction fee is waived for these specific scenarios.ued.      

 

Procedure

1. Contact Etihad Airways Contact Centre to make the name correction – make sure that you have the applicable documents.

 

2. Where fees apply, make the payment in cash or by credit card. You may also issue an Electronic Miscellaneous Document (EMD) with RFISC 98J, stating the reason as Name Correction in the endorsement field.

 

3. Etihad will verify the documents and payment then correct the name on the booking. Once the name is corrected by Etihad, the new name will appear on your reservation system and you may reissue the ticket. This applies to itineraries involving Etihad Airways (607) tickets with Etihad-operated and marketed flights.

 

4. Reissue the ticket with endorsement showing “TKT REISSUED FOR NAME CORR”.

 

5. If there is a date change, a penalty fee will apply as per the fare rules.

 

6. If name corrections are made without an Electronic Miscellaneous Document (EMD), an Agent Debit Memo (ADM) of US $100* or equivalent will be raised against the booking/ticketing office/travel agency that has made the change (*AU $150 for point of sale Australia).

 

7.  When a name correction is requested on an EY (607) ticket involving any other airline (OAL):

 

  a) Create a new booking (PNR) with the correct name on available RBDs. Do not attempt to correct names on the original booking when other airline segments are involved.

  b)  EMD can be issued by Etihad Airways or Travel agent. Post name correction by Etihad, as a Travel agent, you can reissue the ticket. If you wish Etihad to reissue the ticket, then GSF will apply.

  c)  Reissue the original ticket with the correct name on the new PNR with the applicable fare difference (if any). Current fares must be used to reprice.

  d) Cancel the old booking (PNR).

 

Change fees  

Date change penalties apply only if there is a change in the flight itinerary. Global service fees (if applicable) will be collected in addition to the name correction fee if there is a date change and the ticket is being reissued by Etihad Airways. 

 

Name correction and associated EMDs

- When a name correction is made on a booking, the associated EMD will disassociate from the booking. Name corrections on the associated EMD should only be made by Etihad Airways.

- Etihad Airways must verify the EMD for name correction fees. Once the name is corrected, all associated EMDs such as bags, seats etc. should be re-associated to the guest’s name.

- As a Travel agent, you can reissue the ticket from your end to ensure you have custody over the booking/ VCR. Should you wish to have the ticket reissued by Etihad, you will be subjected to GSF and have no custody of the booking. For any future changes, you will need to contact the call centre to make changes and be subjected to GSF as well.

If a ticket is voided, the associated itinerary is cancelled after 4 hours of void transaction.

records.title: Standard Schedule Change Policy
records.html:
Schedule changes are planned or unplanned flight amendments that occur more than 72 hours before the scheduled departure time.

 

Planned schedule changes

Schedule change refers to the airline changing the scheduled departure time, date or flight number or cancellation of a particular flight between the date of issue (or booking) and the actual travel date.

 

Unplanned scheduled changes

Changes are strategically declared, but re-accommodations are not pre-planned. Commercial waivers are issued only when the schedule change deviates from the standard scheduled change policy.

 

Policy

Guests booked on Etihad Airways (607 document) are provided with involuntary rebooking /refund options if they are impacted by following situations:

- Departure is earlier or delayed by 120 minutes or more from the scheduled departure time of either the outbound, inbound, or connecting flight. 

- The guest misses a connection due to a schedule change.

- Flight cancellation.

- Equipment downgrade where the guest is rebooked to a lower cabin.

records.text:
Schedule changes are planned or unplanned flight amendments that occur more than 72 hours before the scheduled departure time.

 

Planned schedule changes

Schedule change refers to the airline changing the scheduled departure time, date or flight number or cancellation of a particular flight between the date of issue (or booking) and the actual travel date.

 

Unplanned scheduled changes

Changes are strategically declared, but re-accommodations are not pre-planned. Commercial waivers are issued only when the schedule change deviates from the standard scheduled change policy.

 

Policy

Guests booked on Etihad Airways (607 document) are provided with involuntary rebooking /refund options if they are impacted by following situations:

- Departure is earlier or delayed by 120 minutes or more from the scheduled departure time of either the outbound, inbound, or connecting flight. 

- The guest misses a connection due to a schedule change.

- Flight cancellation.

- Equipment downgrade where the guest is rebooked to a lower cabin.

 

Irrespective of the type of change, it is the responsibility of reservation agents to notify guests and always ensure alignment between the booking itinerary and ticket details. Tickets should be revalidated or reissued accordingly.

 

View Standard Schedule Change Policy in English

records.title: US DOT Refund Mandate
records.html:
The U.S. Department of Transportation (Department or DOT) is requiring automatic refunds to consumers when a U.S. air carrier or a foreign air carrier cancel or makes a significant change(>6hrs) to a scheduled flight to, from, or within the United States and the consumer is not offered or rejects alternative transportation and travel credits, vouchers, or other compensation. These automatic refunds must be provided promptly, i.e., within 7 business days for credit card payments and within 20 calendar days for other forms of payment. To ensure consumers know when they are entitled to a refund, the Department is requiring carriers and ticket agents to inform consumers of their right to a refund if that is the case before making an offer for alternative transportation, travel credits, vouchers, or other compensation in lieu of refunds.

 

Agents are required to process the refund of a ticket or EMD through their respective GDS or request for refund through BSP/ARC application and also send an email with subject line “USA INV REF-7 days rule” to EtihadRefunds@etihad.ae to expediate the refund process.
